chunks.content: ## Constructing a Fly and Zipper Closure in CLO This section details the step-by-step process of creating a fly and zipper closure on pants using CLO, focusing on manipulating British Files, using various tools like Adjustment Files, Automatic Filing, Collar Expansion, and Iceberg, and running simulations for accurate garment fitting. ### Importing and Preparing British Files - In the picture window, open the British Files folder. - Locate the 'D' file in the scene details labeled "Constructing a fly and zipper closure." - Drag this file into either the 2D or 3D window on the PantsFly file. - Since British Files are asymmetrical, create a symmetrical pair by copying and pasting the existing file: - In the 2D window, right-click on the British Files and select **Copy**. - Right-click again and select **Paste**. - Move the copied file with the mouse and click to place it, ensuring no overlap occurs between the original and copied files. ### Merging and Adjusting Files with Automatic Filing Tool - Use the **Automatic Filing** tool to merge the left- and right-hand British Files. - Modify the filing type to **Tint** for better results. - After simulation, the merged hander (fly) will appear flatter and more natural. - Repeat merging as necessary to combine multiple related Files. ### Creating Inner Lines Using Collar Expansion - Select the base line on the right-hand British Files using the **Collar Expansion** tool. - Press the **Return** key to create an inner line within the pattern. - Use the Automatic Filing tool again to merge the newly created inner lines. ### Positioning and Checking Files in 3D - In the 3D window, select the right-hand British Files. - Right-click and select **Add** from the menu to add another file. - Use the **Location** tool to place the added file precisely. - Check the gap between files to ensure proper alignment. ### Adjusting Inner Lines with the Iceberg Tool - Use the **Iceberg** tool and right-click on the right-hand side of the iceberg. - Select the inner line from the menu. - Input the desired value and confirm with **OK**. - Use the **Line Filling** tool to merge the newly created inner lines. ### Simulation and Cleanup - Activate the simulation and set it to **3D clothing** to visualize the garment. - In the 2D window, right-click on the left-hand British Files and delete the inner line if no longer needed. - Use the **High-Quality Clothing** tool and confirm by clicking **OK**. - Re-activate the simulation with 3D clothing settings for final adjustments. ### Additional Simulation Controls - In the selection set, move all related elements and garment movements to the right-hand side. - Execute the simulation focusing on the right-hand side to finalize the fly and zipper closure appearance. --- This detailed procedure ensures accurate construction and simulation of a fly and zipper closure on pants within CLO, using precise file management and multiple specialized tools for pattern adjustment and garment fitting.
